note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. Every building, space and participant is generic and fictional; the separation is shown as configured (illustrative). Nothing states who may attend, a secrecy or confidentiality rule, a vote, a hierarchy, a time span or any outcome.
